messages:
rafael: Quick follow-up from the streaming postmortem — hotfixes deployed but we need a compact ownership plan for remaining items (timeouts, partials, reconnect).
meera: Yep, list please.
rafael: Items: 1) SDK retry/backoff defaults, 2) server resume handshake with short KV retention, 3) prefix-cache TTL audit + extra logs, 4) nightly regression job to catch partial responses, 5) dashboards + weekly recurrence digest.
nina: I can own (3). ETA: Friday EOD. Need a small infra lift for log retention.
sean: I'll take (1). PR later today, aiming to release tomorrow. Backoff: exp 200ms->8s + jitter.
meera: I'll own (4) and coordinate with runtime for (2). Plan: extend stream-harness with randomized chunking + network jitter, run nightly. Target: next Tue.
oncall-lee: ops-bot shows regional tail in eu-west-1 around 03:00 UTC. I'll add a heatmap and autoscale-correlation panels, and enable slow-trace capture for reconnects >2s.
ops-bot: Alert: streaming-timeout-rate spiked to 4.1% on 2026-03-15T03:12Z (threshold 1%).
rafael: For (2) proposed behavior: keep KV cache for 3s after disconnect, accept resume token in that window. Draft spec on Confluence.
nina: Hypothesis: truncated client close frames causing stale prefixes. I'll add session_close_reason and kv_ttl_hit logs plus metric stream_prefix_kv_ttl_miss. Query suggestion: sum(rate(stream_session_close_total{reason!~"normal|client_closed"}[5m])) by (region).
meera: Regression job details: nightly harness runs with several jitter profiles. If partial-response rate >0.5% over 1h -> auto-file GH issue.
sean: I'll add CHANGELOG and compatibility notes, ping #devex after release.
rafael: Ownership recap: SDK=sean, Resume=eng-runtime (meera to coordinate), Cache=nina, Regression=meera, Monitoring=oncall-lee.
sean: Filing SDK-502 for the SDK change.
nina: Filing INFR-4231 for prefix-cache TTL audit.
meera: Filing STREAM-805 for the regression job.
oncall-lee: Filing DASH-217 for heatmap + weekly digest.
rafael: Timeline: SDK release by tomorrow; cache logs by Friday; regression job by next Tue; resume spec review in 48h; dashboards/digest by EOW. Flag slips here.
sean: :thumbsup:
nina: :thumbsup:
meera: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar: "Streaming postmortem follow-up" scheduled 2026-03-24T16:30Z (invite sent).
